reader.requirement: At 85 RECORD DELIMITER IS STANDARD-1 must frame variable-length records by the X3.27-1978 / ISO 1001 magnetic-tape method; the element is on the 1985 hardware-dependent list (reel devices), so an implementation that claims no reel device may omit it if the absence is documented (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.1).

edition-consulted.switches: DELIMITER and STANDARD-1 reserved at all four editions

reader.edition-search: EditionContext#Declined reads the descriptor severity and Permissive only; grep of Validation (VersionConformancePass, ClosedFormatPass), Editions and ConstructRegistry for recordDelimiter / RECORD DELIMITER found no gate; the EntryClauses row for the clause has no edition predicate.
reader.witnesses-cover: all of the rule's range at this edition: files A and C of pb292 write STANDARD-1 with and without IS

probes.printed: warning COBOL1778 on F1 (RECORD DELIMITER IS STANDARD-1) and F3 (RECORD DELIMITER STANDARD-1); run output MATCH; pb292rd1a.dat framed 03 00 00 00 ABC 08 00 00 00 ..., the same framing as the no-clause file
probes.expected: declined by name with the documented implementor framing in its place

probes.expected: 1985 prints the clause in the sequential file control entry only (§1985:VII.2.3.2): refused on relative and indexed entries

the required choice is missing: refused

reader.notes: The clause is declined whole and accepted inert with warning COBOL1778 at every edition (docs/conformance/2/26.md, kb/Work PB292); the 1985 hardware-dependent list names STANDARD-1 as dependent on a reel device, and §1985:I.1.5.2.5.1 lets an implementation that claims no reel omit it if the absence is specified, which the conformance row does. Verdict by the kb/Work PB5373 class-3 decision (a rule whose subject is an element declined by documented decision is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT, witnessed by the named diagnostic at --std 85). PB292 records that the owner question (provide the tape framing?) was raised but not answered; COBOL1778's text cites the 2023 clauses at --std 85.
